results.rationale: Consistency: the numbered gauge, timber supports and dock structure remain in their original positions. Instruction: dark rippled water becomes pale and foamy, but the waterline stays at roughly the same point near 6 instead of decreasing. Knowledge: the supplied lower-level expectation is not met. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: the foamy water, reflections and dock are coherent and naturally rendered.

Consistency: yellow color and neutral setting remain, but boot shaft widths, contours and relative positions are altered. Instruction: both boots still have large open toes; the unreasonable rain-boot openings are not corrected. Quality: as a rendered pair of open-toed footwear, the shapes, soles, material and shadows are coherent without distracting artifacts.
